name: Roland RD-700GX
description: Roland RD-700GX digital stage piano (2008): the system blocks and the temporary SETUP — common, rhythm/arpeggio, sound control, chorus, reverb, the MFX the map addresses, the Internal and External Zone of each of its four keyboard zones, and the sixteen Parts with each Part's Piano, E.Piano and ToneWheel settings — from the MIDI Implementation.

sources.title: RD-700GX MIDI Implementation (version 1.00, Feb. 1, 2008)
sources.notes: Parameter Address Map read by tools/profiles/roland/parse-address-map.mjs from RD-700GX_MI.pdf (sha256 2728924413e1dbc6399f51b6dca1b16a03aaab2205176a1a021cb579c1a0586e). Model ID 00 00 2B, DT1 = 12, RQ1 = 11, Roland checksum. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/roland/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/roland/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is the manual's, at the manual's address, with the manual's name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.

Presets list the SETUPs (Bank Select MSB 85, LSB 0, p1), which are recalled on the SETUP Control Channel (System Common 00 05), which must match the profile's channel. The table's other rows (GM/GM2 tones and rhythm sets, Rhythm Set 86/64, the tone categories 87/64 and up) select a Part's sound, which the Part block sets by bank and program number.

Not laid out: five of the eight SETUP MFX blocks. The offset table (p9) prints "00 10 00 SETUP MFX (UPPER1 MFX1)", "00 12 00 SETUP MFX (UPPER1 MFX2)", ":", "00 1E 00 SETUP MFX (LOWER2 MFX2)"; the run counts zones and MFX slots rather than a number, so the reader leaves the five between as a gap, and a layout can only name an entry the map holds.

p14 <Example1> ends "This means that F0 41 10 00 43 12 10 00 04 00 02 6A F7 is the message should be sent": 00 43 is the RD-700's model ID, and the sentence is the RD-700 manual's. The same page's byte diagram, the DT1 tables (p6, p8) and the address map's heading (p9) give 00 00 2B, and the checked example is F0 41 10 00 00 2B 12 10 00 04 00 02 6A F7.

System Favorite SETUP (p9) prints two rows at 00 1B: "Favorite SETUP7 (Bank C)" and "Favorite SETUP8 (Bank C)", and none at 00 1C. SETUP8 (Bank C) is by its place 00 1C, but the page does not say so; the first row is kept and the second left out.

SETUP Common (p10) prints no rows at 00 3D - 00 5A (between Upper [RHY/GM2] and Lower [Piano] Tone Category) and 00 79 - 01 16 (between Lower [RHY/GM2] Tone Category and FC 1 Assign) — thirty bytes each, ten three-nibble categories' worth — nor at 01 3A, and its rows end at 01 4A against a Total Size of 00 00 01 4D; the block is requested whole.
SETUP Common prints its two mid EQ bands with the same names (EQ Mid Frequency/Gain/Q at 01 25-01 27 and 01 28-01 2A, p10); they are numbered 1 and 2 in printed order.

SETUP Common's EQ frequency lists print "200.250" for "200, 250" (p10), so they count 30 labels for 31 values and stay numbers 0 - 30 with the manual's list as their description. Harmonic Bar Assign prints its footage list under LOWER2:ON only; the other seven stay numbers 1 - 9.
SETUP MFX (p11) starts at 00 02 (MFX Type); 00 00 - 00 01 and 00 04 - 00 0F print no rows.

Printed names kept as printed: "MFX Knob1 Assgin" and "MFX Knob2 Assgin" (SETUP Common 01 19-01 1A), "Control Slider Swtch" (SETUP Internal Zone 00 0D-00 10), "ToneBar Bell Lebel" and "HAM Noise Lelve" (Setup E.Piano Setting 00 03, 00 06). System S2 Assign's list prints "DCOUPLE+2OCT" and "STADRT/STOP" (p9), kept as labels.

Arpeggio Motif (SETUP Rhythm/Arpeggio 00 09) prints a full stop for a comma ("UP(H&L).UP(_)") and "RHASE" (p11), so its list counts eleven labels for twelve values; it stays a number 0 - 11. Setup E.Piano Setting's ModelType (0 - 7) prints no labels.

Not read at startup (read on request, since the instrument may not answer them): part1.piano, part1.ePiano, part1.toneWheel, part2.piano, part2.ePiano, part2.toneWheel, part3.piano, part3.ePiano, part3.toneWheel, part4.piano, part4.ePiano, part4.toneWheel, part5.piano, part5.ePiano, part5.toneWheel, part6.piano, part6.ePiano, part6.toneWheel, part7.piano, part7.ePiano, part7.toneWheel, part8.piano, part8.ePiano, part8.toneWheel, part9.piano, part9.ePiano, part9.toneWheel, part10.piano, part10.ePiano, part10.toneWheel, part11.piano, part11.ePiano, part11.toneWheel, part12.piano, part12.ePiano, part12.toneWheel, part13.piano, part13.ePiano, part13.toneWheel, part14.piano, part14.ePiano, part14.toneWheel, part15.piano, part15.ePiano, part15.toneWheel, part16.piano, part16.ePiano, part16.toneWheel.
system.favorites: the manual prints "Favorite SETUP8 (Bank C)" at 00 1B, which another row already holds; left out

coverage.inboundControllers: not modelled: what the sliders, knobs, pedals and S1/S2 transmit as CC (Data Transmission, p6-8) is not mapped yet
coverage.effectParameterMeanings: type-dependent: chorus, reverb and MFX parameters are Roland's 4-nibble container (12768-52768, shown -20000..+20000); what each slot does depends on the selected type, which the MIDI Implementation does not list
coverage.mfx: partial: three of the eight SETUP MFX blocks — UPPER1 MFX1 (10 00 10 00), UPPER1 MFX2 (10 00 12 00) and LOWER2 MFX2 (10 00 1E 00), the entries the offset table prints (p9). The five it elides with ":" between them, at 10 00 14 00, 10 00 16 00, 10 00 18 00, 10 00 1A 00 and 10 00 1C 00 (by the arithmetic UPPER2 MFX1/MFX2, LOWER1 MFX1/MFX2, LOWER2 MFX1), have no entry in the map and are not laid out
coverage.memories: none in the map: the SETUP memories (001-100, p1) have no addresses in the MIDI Implementation
